name: io.github.thalisantunes/mcp-kicad
title: KiCad 10 MCP
description: MCP server for KiCad 10 over the IPC API and kicad-cli, with JLCPCB fabrication rules bundled.

environmentVariables.name: KICAD_API_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: KiCad IPC API socket path (injected by KiCad when the GUI is running)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_KICAD_CLI
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kicad-cli binary if it is not on PATH
